(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not account for the added thickness of the trivalent zinc plating specified in the title block. The plating will reduce the bore diameter and may prevent the mating shaft from assembling; the designer must either open the pre-plate machining limits or add a note to mask/rework the bore after plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Adjust the pre-plate hole size to allow for plating buildup, or specify masking/machining of the bore after plating."}]}
